<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1063
Claimant:
Michael Oconnor
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2024-12-15
First notice of loss received for a side impact at an intersection. The insured reports the other vehicle entered on a red
siganl and struck the driver's side door.
2025-03-12
Police report obtained. The responding officer confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision and
notes the scene layout matches the account given.
2025-04-06
Spoke with the insured, who confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the vehicle was insured on the
date of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
2025-04-13
Claimant is represented by counsel. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Requested medical
authorizations and prior records.
2025-04-28
Recorded statement taken from the claimant's representative. The claimant has described the collision the same way
in every conversation so far, including the sequence of impact and the position of the vehicles.
2025-05-04
Witness statements and scene photogarphs reviewed. Witnesses, the photos and the other driver all agree the
accident happened as described.
2025-05-31
Field inspection completed. Damage is consistent with a side impact to the driver's door and panel. A few old
scratches near the rear wheel well may be older than this crash, so they are noted separately for now.
2025-06-18
Medical records received showing neck and back strain. It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash,
and the treating notes do not yet address the question directly.
2025-06-25
Treatment has run somewhat longer than usual for this type of strain. No earlier injury to the same body area is
known from the records requested so far. Follow-up with the treating physician is pending.
2025-07-07
Repair estimate reviewed. It is not clear whether all of the listed damage came from this impact, so the body shop has
been asked to separate pre-existing wear from new collision damage.
2025-07-08
File remains open pending medical causation review, the repair breakdown, and a response from the claimant's
attorney on the outstanding records request.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
